# CoffeeMode

CoffeeMode is a crowdsourced guide to cafes worth working from, built by
and for digital nomads. Instead of vibes, it records facts from real work
sessions: wifi, outlets, seats/tables, temperature, and coffee quality —
each scored 0–100 — plus nomad policies (minimum spend, maximum stay).

- Every cafe lives at a permanent URL: /cafes/{id} (canonical, id-based —
  stable across renames).
- Cafe pages publish aggregate scores, dimension breakdowns, policy
  consensus, opening hours, and photos.
- Two scores per cafe: a weighted Work score (wifi 30%, outlets 20%,
  seats 20%, temperature 15%, coffee 15%) and an Experience score (mean
  overall rating).
- Full sitemap: /sitemap.xml
